## Fungus Man King (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
Giant fungus man druid 6  
N Large plant (fungus)  
**Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 30 ft., low-light vision; Perception +12  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 9, flat-footed 16 (+7 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 174 (12d8+78)  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +4, **Will** +11; +4 bonus vs. confusion, daze, feeblemind, and insanity effects, +4 bonus vs. extraordinary, spell-like, and supernatural abilities of creatures with shapechanger subtype  
**Defensive Abilities** bramble armor (1d6+3, 6 rounds/day); **DR** 5/piercing or slashing; **Immune** plant traits; **Resist** cold 5  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** slam +13 (1d6+7)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** spore cloud, wild shape 2/day, wooden fists (+3, 5 rounds/day)  
**Druid Spells Prepared** (CL 6th; concentration +8)  

3rd—plant growth<sup>D</sup>, protection from energy, speak with plants  
2nd—barkskin<sup>D</sup>, flame blade, fog cloud, hold animal (DC 14), protection from spores  
1st—charm animal (DC 13), entangle<sup>D</sup> (DC 13), obscuring mist, produce flame, thunderstomp  
0 (at will)—create water, mending, purify food and drink (DC 12), stabilize  

**D** Domain spell; **Domain** Plant domain  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 11, **Con** 22, **Int** 9, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 24  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Iron Will, Natural Spell, Skill Focus (Perception), Voice of Beasts, Wild Speech, [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +0 (-4 to jump), Heal +10, Knowledge (geography) +3, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +12, Stealth +11, Survival +8  
**SQ** nature bond (Plant domain), nature sense, resist call of the wild, trackless step, wild empathy +6  

**Bramble Armor (6 rounds/day) (Su)** Foes striking the fungus king with non-reach weapons take 1d6+3 slashing damage from brambles cutting their flesh.  

**Darkvision (30 ft.)** The fungus king can see perfectly in the dark up to 30 ft. (black and white only).  

**Natural Spell** The fungus king can cast spells while using wild shape.  

**Nature Sense (Ex)** The fungus king gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.  

**Resist Call of the Wild (Ex)** The fungus king gains a +4 bonus to saves vs. confusion, daze, feeblemind, insanity, or shapechanger abilities.  

**Spore Cloud (Ex)** Once per round as a standard action, a fungus king can release a cloud of noxious spores. All living creatures within 5 ft. must make a DC 19 Fortitude save or become nauseated 1 for 1d4+1 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based. This is a poison effect, and once a creature successfully saves it is immune to the spore cloud of that particular fungus man for 24 hours.
